summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity securities and a dividend declaration. On May 1, 2026, it issued and sold 6,427,841 common shares (Classes S, I, F-S, F-I) for gross proceeds of ~$67.1 million at net asset value per share. The sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S. Separately, on April 30, 2026, the company declared distributions of $0.0728 per share across all classes, payable May 1, 2026, in cash or reinvested. These are routine capital-raising and distribution activities, not a special situation.
